items.section: Injury to Crew or Third Party

procedures.checklist_entry: Trigger: Confirmed physical injury requiring medical attention
procedures.procedure_description: Any crew member or third party with confirmed physical injury.

procedures.checklist_entry: Contact radio room for medical response ([LOCAL_CONTACT_NUMBER])
procedures.procedure_description: Provide location (patrol block), injury nature, and casualty count.

procedures.checklist_entry: Notify Field Safety Coordinator (Designated Safety Coordinator)
Trigger: Confirmed impact or harm to wildlife caused by UAS
procedures.procedure_description: Incident involving wildlife impact or harm from UAS operations.
Contact the conservancy team to report and manage the incident.

procedures.checklist_entry: Notify Field Safety Coordinator (Designated Safety Coordinator)
Trigger: Visible flames, smoke, battery overheating, or bush fire
procedures.procedure_description: Apply this procedure in the event of fire involving UAS, batteries, ground equipment, or a bush/grass fire in the operational area.
Move all personnel upwind and away from the fire. Do not attempt to fight the fire. LiPo batteries can reignite.

procedures.checklist_entry: Contact radio room for fire response ([LOCAL_CONTACT_NUMBER])
procedures.procedure_description: Report fire location (patrol block), size, and direction of spread.

procedures.checklist_entry: Notify Field Safety Coordinator (Designated Safety Coordinator)
procedures.procedure_description: Call the designated safety coordinator and report the fire.
Keep all personnel and vehicles away from burning batteries or equipment. LiPo batteries can reignite.

procedures.checklist_entry: Trigger: Confirmed contact or credible report of collision
procedures.procedure_description: Apply this procedure when a confirmed or credible collision between the UAS and a manned aircraft has occurred.
Provide: UAS type, last known location, altitude, speed, heading, and remaining battery.

procedures.checklist_entry: Notify Field Safety Coordinator (Designated Safety Coordinator)
procedures.procedure_description: Call the designated safety coordinator without delay.
Do not delete flight logs, images, or controller data. Record time, location, and all witness accounts.

procedures.checklist_entry: Trigger: Confirmed impact beyond controlled operational areas
procedures.procedure_description: Apply this procedure when the UAS has crashed or landed outside the conservancy boundaries or controlled operational areas.
If third parties or property are affected, contact local authorities as directed by the Field Safety Coordinator.

procedures.checklist_entry: Notify Field Safety Coordinator (Designated Safety Coordinator)
procedures.procedure_description: Call the designated safety coordinator and report the incident, location, and any third-party involvement.
